message: `AutomationDefinition.disableConditions` supports `finiteRuns` (`maxRuns`) and `finalDate` rules combined with logical OR, with at most one condition per kind. Host-owned `AutomationEntry.scheduledRunCount` tracks the current scheduled-run allowance. Edit conditions through `automation/updateRequested`: omission leaves them unchanged, an array replaces them, and `[]` removes all conditions without re-enabling the automation.
